scope: D10 drive probe on an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 with an added SINAMICS G120C PN (6SL3210-1KE21-3AF1 V4.7.14): device compile through project_compile with save compiles the PLC station and lists the drive under notCompiled; drive_observe before and after compile and save; drive_parameter_set and drive_telegram_set preparation answers. Frozen Debug build of 807a1891 in artifacts/ob2.
limitations: This is a boundary record, not a qualification of the drive kinds: Startdrive cannot read DriveObject.DriveObjectNumber on the new drive before or after compile and save, so drive_observe returns no drive objects and both change kinds refuse at preparation with EngineeringError.
The drive is not connected to the CPU's IO system and has not been configured in Startdrive's commissioning UI.
Offline engineering only; no online values, upload, download or RAM-to-ROM.

steps: apply hardware_add without compile or save
drive_observe of the new unsaved drive
project_compile lists the drive as not compiled
record the drive_parameter_set answer without readable drive objects
record the drive_telegram_set answer without readable drive objects
